questions.q: A restaurant kitchen needs a printer that survives heat and steam and can highlight priority orders in red. Which Epson model fits?
questions.e: The TM-U220 is a 9-pin impact printer; impact survives kitchen heat where thermal fades, and the two-colour ribbon highlights priority items.

questions.q: On receipt printers, what is IOR's recommended competitive posture?
o: Displace Epson with Bixolon wherever possible
Lead with Epson; use the TM-T20IV as the value answer to price-led challengers
questions.e: Epson is the leader and IOR's lead receipt-printer brand; sell reliability and compatibility, and use the TM-T20IV to defend against price-led competition.

questions.q: Which Epson printer is purpose-built for tablet/cloud POS, with USB-C power delivery and integrated Bluetooth and Wi-Fi in a compact cube?
questions.e: The TM-m30III is the mPOS unit: USB-C PD to power a tablet, integrated Bluetooth/Wi-Fi, tiny footprint, ePOS-Print for cloud apps.
